title: Check: Volume of Pyramids and Cones

questions.stem: A cone and a cylinder have the same base radius and height. The volume of the cone is $50\text{ cm}^3$. What is the volume of the cylinder?
questions.explanation: A cone has $\frac{1}{3}$ the volume of a cylinder with the same base and height. If the cone is $50\text{ cm}^3$, the cylinder is $3 \times 50 = 150\text{ cm}^3$.
